description_zh: 计费管理/批量查询计费明细
name: ModelRouterQueryBillingCostBreakdown

parameters.help_en: The query start time, in UNIX timestamp (seconds)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix时间戳（秒）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The query end time, in UNIX timestamp (seconds)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix时间戳（秒）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation granularity. Valid values:

hourly
daily
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by model ID
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by department ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by API key ID. This parameter is linked with the department. Specify clientId first
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按 API Key ID 过滤（与部门联动，需先指定 clientId）
parameters.name: api_key_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by model type. Separate multiple values with commas
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按模型类型过滤，多个用逗号分隔
parameters.name: model_types

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by member ID. Separate multiple values with commas. If not specified, the department and all its members are included. If an empty value is specified, only the department is included without members
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按成员过滤（成员ID，多个用逗号分隔）。不传=部门及其全部成员；传空值=仅部门不含成员
parameters.name: member_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results
